हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: At the center is Shanaya Mehra, a woman trapped between a toxic husband Arjun Raichand and the scheming Rhea Malhotra, who will do anything to take her place. Every episode unfolds with high-voltage confrontations, tears, and shocking revelations—where loyalty is tested, lies unravel, and survival becomes Shanaya’s only fight.
